name: Everything Is Watching
hint: Six takes, and every hazard in the room is switched off by a body standing somewhere. Plate p1 at x=4 takes the turret offline; the perch at x=9.8 pins walker w1 at the LEFT end of its x=10..22 span; plates p2 (x=23) and p3 (x=26) together open the door at x=29; plate p4 (x=31.5) beyond that door kills the laser at x=33.5. TAKE 1: walk onto p1 and stand. It is outside the turret's reach and left of the walker's span, so it is safe. TAKE 2: Echo A keeps the turret dark. Climb the step at x=7..9.2 and up onto the perch at x=9.8 (1.8 then 2.4) and stand; w1 crowds beneath and cannot reach you. TAKE 3: with w1 pinned near x=10, go over its head instead of through it — climb the step and perch, hop the 0.2 gap onto the catwalk at x=12.4..22.4, run right and drop off the end onto p2 at x=23. Stand. TAKE 4: same route, drop and stand on p3 at x=26; the door at x=29 opens the moment both are held. TAKE 5: same route again, but this time carry on through the open doorway and stand on p4 at x=31.5, which puts the laser out. TAKE 6: five bodies are holding the room still — the turret is dark, the guard is staring at a recording, the door is open and the laser is dead. Take the catwalk, drop at x=22.4, and run right through the doorway, across the dead laser lane, to the exit at x=36. Everything that could kill you is being held shut by someone who used to be you.

dialogue.text: A gun, a guard, a door and a beam. Five of you, one of each.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: You will walk out of here alone and it will look like nothing happened.
